name: Ignition
summary: At a Venture Company camp in the northern Barrens, a trapped pilot needs an ignition key before their cover fails. The operative hijacked a shredder without its key and needs someone to fetch it from the site supervisor.

sections.title: A Heist Gone Sideways
sections.body: A spy sent by Sputtervalve has slipped into a Venture Company shredder at the northern Barrens drilling grounds. The operative means to seize the machine and study how it works. But the steering and movement column stays locked without its ignition key.

sections.title: Bluffing Under Pressure
sections.body: A goblin worker has noticed the shredder sitting idle, so the hijacker bluffs that its engine has failed. Trapped beneath the glass canopy with workers nearby, the operative points you toward the central derrick. The supervisor keeps spare ignition keys in the upper control office, the only way out before the bluff fails.

sections.title: Corporate Jealousy
sections.body: The key turns, and the thief studies the shredder's controls. Its precise arm levers, rotation controls, and stability dampeners surpass the clumsy machines operating out of Ratchet. The machine is now a prize of industrial espionage as well as the pilot's way to survive.

faq.answer: An operative connected to Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet, is inside the shredder. The pilot entered the Venture Company operation to steal one of its advanced wood-clearing machines.

faq.q: Why can't the shredder simply drive away?
faq.answer: The shredder's movement column is locked without its ignition key. The hijacker reached the cockpit, but the machine cannot move until the key unlocks its drive controls.

faq.q: Where is the Ignition Key found?
faq.answer: The Venture Company supervisor has the ignition key. The supervisor is in the control room atop the nearby wooden derrick.

faq.q: Why does Ratchet want a Venture Company shredder?
faq.answer: Ratchet wants a Venture Company shredder because its engineering outclasses the standard models used there. An intact machine could let local tinkerers study its arm controls, speed regulators, and stability systems.
Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer and operative in Ratchet. Sputtervalve watches the Venture Company's expansion and seeks its mechanical innovations.

faq.q: What happens after the shredder is started?
faq.answer: Turning the key unlocks the shredder's movement systems. The pilot then tries to drive the hijacked machine out of the hostile drilling camp and back to safety, with an escort operation underway.

angles.text: The Venture Company's shredder uses precise arm controls and responsive rotation governors, beyond the usual tinkering in Ratchet.
The Venture Company's reckless deforestation threatens the northern Barrens. Sabotaging or stealing its heavy machinery disrupts that work.
